notes.title: 0.4 Update and finishing up
notes.content: Konnichiwa! Hello! Introducing the latest update, 0.4, of Matsudaira's Myoshu: A Sengoku Village Simulator! Prepare to immerse yourself in a historic land brimming with new features, including a dynamic weather system, a Myoshu welcome celebration was added, and a new intro movie to introduce you to your goals. Examine the new vibrant landscapes teeming with flora, each coded with a different hue to give variety. We added a plethora of new achievements bringing the total to 42! We also have been fine tuning and balancing the game as well as hunting down any final pesky bugs. And good news! This is the last update planned before our highly anticipated demo release for June NextFest! Secure your spot in history by wishlisting the game on Steam today and give the demo a try for NextFest June 10-17!
